metric: E(x,g) = sum_d (z_d(x)-z_d(g))^2; unnormalized 192-dimensional current projected states; no actions or predicted rollout
color_direction: viridis_r: yellow low cost, purple high cost; linear normalization; each checkpoint shares one scale across both goals
display: 20x20 candidate lattice; 210 valid evaluated centers; per-room 8-neighbor inverse squared-distance floor interpolation, weights=1/(distance_squared+0.001); 85% color + 15% original floor; walls, cue markers and reference agent preserved
reference_marker: red agent disk shows the goal position; upper-leaf goal top row, lower-leaf goal bottom row
scope: Three matched CLS+IDM epoch-10 checkpoints; one common layout; no new model inference or training; colors are comparable across goals within a column, not numerically across checkpoint columns
